description_ko: 꽃 유리 실린더를 복부로 삼고 원예 가위를 두 거대한 절단 날개로 바꾼 태엽 나방. 작은 비인간형 가면과 두 개의 짧은 걸쇠 다리, 넓은 M자 날개 실루엣.

references.role: Only material palette, preserved blue-flower cylinder, gardening-tool identity; no humanoid anatomy or face lock
Physical winding drum, teal spring construction and porcelain leaf plates; no anatomy/pose/proportions lock

visual_qa.silhouette: Wide M-shaped moth with exactly two primary connected wing assemblies, compact glass abdomen and small angular nonhuman faceplate. No normal cap-wearing woman's head, no feminine doll waist/hips/skirt and no handheld scissors.
visual_qa.identity: Exactly one blue flower and green stem in brass-capped glass abdomen, dark teal cap-like armored crest, two ivory curled antennae, physical brass winding drum, ivory/teal/brass materials.
visual_qa.anatomy: Two folded slim tool arms with claws and exactly two small hooked dangling legs, distinct pairs. No four-legged or six-legged support anatomy. Main wings attach by visible brass frames and pivots to the thorax/back mechanism.
visual_qa.weapon: Pruning blades become two large ivory cutting wing profiles with deep teal leaf panel bodies. One coherent connected wing architecture; no duplicate loose scissors.
visual_qa.framing: All wing, spring, antenna and leg tips are inside the canvas. Left/right wing outer tips have approximately 6 percent blank side margin; no clipping. Clearly separated cast shadow establishes hover.
visual_qa.method: Complete generatedImage result visually inspected. Saved PNG decoded at 1536x1024 and identical SHA-256 to generation original. Saved view_image showed the known thin pale strip display artifact, so the saved PNG was decoded in headless Chrome to a JPEG review at .utmp/flora-stage2-v3/moth-review.jpg and visually inspected at full size; the complete design is valid.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view 2D candidate, not selected. No Tripo multi-view, mesh, rig or flight/wing articulation testing.
